notes: v3.0.104 - Pull reliability: schedule rows that sit under a provider heading (the way athenaOne groups a Day or Week view by provider) now carry that provider, so a provider-scoped month pull files them instead of refusing every day with "no provider identity"; a date navigation that saw the calendar strip but could not reach the day now runs the full recovery ladder instead of retrying a dead arrow; the date check reads the header of the frame that owns the schedule, not any frame. Everything from v3.0.103 remains. Requires Chrome 116+.
